about: Held-out comparison: 60 questions asked through the live web page by three models, compared in pairs by blind LLM judges and scored with Bradley-Terry. Settled verdicts are the shared verdict of judges A and B, or the majority of three where they differed (a tie when all three differ). Strengths are log strengths (geometric mean 1); intervals and the chance of being best come from resampling questions.

judges.judge_c: a fresh Gemini chat, only where judges A and B differed
